resolution: Confirmed through the live chair edit that mirroring is currently an awkward multi-step cleanup workflow: the command infers a hidden per-part bounds center, so a visibly symmetric selection can reflect around the wrong plane, and center-crossing surfaces require manual face merging afterward. No code or model topology was accepted from the experiment; the provisional vertex offset was restored and the resident model returned to the demonstrated 556-triangle state.
